description:
Industry's leading 3D fashion design and development software.

VStitcher combines AI-driven fit intelligence with true-to-life 3D simulation, so you validate, iterate, and approve designs without physical samples slowing you down. With built-in fabric, pattern, and avatar libraries, VStitcher enables style creation and fit validation in one AI-powered 3D workspace, including 2D drafting, 3D draping, avatar fitting, and grading.
VStitcher 2026.2 Release Notes
Release Date: July 30, 2026
VStitcher 2026.2 focuses on precision and control in the 2D workspace. This release adds direct editing of grainlines and notches, multi-2D fold support, consistent export controls across Print to File and Tech Pack, and a set of workspace and shortcut improvements that reduce repetitive manual steps in everyday pattern work.

Fabric Sublimation Workflow - Vector Import & Print Fidelity
- VStitcher now correctly renders Illustrator blending modes (Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Hue, Saturation, etc.) on imported AI/SVG vector artwork, fabrics, trims, and seams — read-only, preserved through PDF (Vector Only) export.
- Embedded bitmaps in imported AI/SVG files now render once in their original position, scale, and rotation — fixing previous unwanted tiling.
Avatar Size Set UI and Functionality Update
- Avatar sizes now match Stylezone standards
- Consistent display across VStitcher
- Auto-resizing for different contexts
2D Fold - Multiple Folds & Folded-State Tool Support
- Create multiple folds on single pattern
- Folded state visualization
- Fold editing and management tools
Note: This update only applies to folded pieces in the 2D window, not a folded piece in 3D.

Grainline - Editable Size & Placement
- Drag grainline to any position on pattern
- Resize grainline dynamically
- Visual feedback shows current position
Preserve Glue Across Graded Sizes
- With Clone by Offset and Extend to Edges, glue is maintained during grading
- Prevents unwanted separation in graded patterns
- Automatic validation on grade completion
Print to File / Tech Pack Consistency
- PDF export matches onscreen appearance exactly
- Tech pack measurements verified against pattern
- Supports all output formats: PDF, PNG, SVG
Note: because single-file and individual-piece export are now mutually exclusive, workflows that relied on the previous checkbox combination will need to re-select their export option.

Keyboard Shortcuts for Flip & Rotate
- New keyboard shortcuts for flip and rotate
- Customizable shortcut mapping in Preferences
Marquee Select & Delete Guidelines
- Visual guidelines appear when using marquee tool
- Safer selection and deletion of pattern elements
Note: marquee selection now includes guidelines by default. Workflows that relied on marquee selection capturing only pieces and internal lines will now also capture guidelines.

Disable Double-Click Handle Type Change
- Prevent accidental handle type changes on double-click
- Toggle on/off in Pattern Settings
- Reduces rework in complex patterns
Fabric Physics & Keyboard Shortcuts
- Fabric Physics engine updated for improved accuracy
- Keyboard shortcuts standardized across tools
- Comprehensive shortcut guide available in Help
Additional Notch Types
- Three new notch styles added: dart, princess, asymmetric, and more
- Each notch type customizable in size and position
- Compatible with existing pattern workflows
Rulers - Show / Hide Toggle
- New toggle in toolbar to show/hide rulers
- Declutter canvas while maintaining alignment guides
- Keyboard shortcut available (customize in Preferences)
